## Rosa's Priorities
​- Proven Leadership, Real Results
​Rosa Kim has spent two terms working tirelessly to bring meaningful results to FUHSD: co-leading successful campaigns to fund our public schools, representing FUHSD at the regional level, and guiding the district through the COVID-19 pandemic. Board service isn't a stepping stone for her; it's where she's already proven she can deliver.
​
- A District That Works for Every Student
​Every family in FUHSD deserves a board member who listens first. Rosa has committed to making sure that happens, building deep relationships across the community and centering student voices that reflect the real diversity of our schools.
​
- Ready for What's Next: Student Wellness and AI-Ready Classrooms
Rosa knows that preparing students for the future means more than test scores. It means continuing to strengthen student mental health support through the district’s holistic programs, and now, making sure FUHSD classrooms responsibly prepare students for a world being reshaped by AI.​

## Margaret Abe-Koga
Santa Clara County Supervisor, District 5
## Rosa leads with compassion, collaboration, and a genuine commitment to making our community stronger. She works hard and advocates fiercely to ensure that all FUHSD students, families and the entire community are heard and represented. She has served with distinction and will continue to do so to provide the best educational opportunities for the community. I am proud to endorse her.
## Otto Lee
Santa Clara County Supervisor, District 3,
Board President
## Rosa Kim is a dedicated, hardworking leader who is passionate to ensure every student has the chance to succeed. I’ve seen her listen to students and families, tackle tough challenges, and always follow through. I’m proud to support her continued leadership on the FUHSD Board
## Homer Tong
Retired 5-term FUHSD Board Member
I have known Rosa for 20 years. She was always involved in Education and youth education. When she was the principal of the local language school, we have worked closely together on Fundraising for our FUHSD District and our communication continues.
She is the real, authentic educator and we are fortunate that she wants to continue serving our students and our community, to help our students in our District to achieve high standards, to be socially well-rounded and emotionally well-developed.

I proudly endorse Rosa Kim for reelection to the Fremont Union High School District Board. Rosa leads with thoughtful reflection, fairness, and a steady hand. Her big heart and deep empathy keep students at the center of her decisions, and the district will continue to benefit from her compassionate leadership.
## Elisabeth Halliday
Trustee, Campbell Union High School District
... I have seen firsthand her extraordinary dedication to our students, families, schools, and community ... Rosa is a passionate advocate for environmental and climate education ... is also deeply committed to students who face barriers to opportunity, including English Learners, and works to ensure they receive the academic support and opportunities they need to succeed... Rosa brings thoughtful, forward-looking perspectives to our budget and carefully oversees bond-funded facilities projects to ensure taxpayer dollars are spent wisely ... I wholeheartedly endorse Rosa Kim for re-election and look forward to continuing to serve alongside her for another four years.
## ​
## Stanley Kou
Board President, FUHSD
## Julie Darwish
Retired FUHSD Administrator
## ...She is not only our school Board member, she is a true volunteer. She has demonstrated an unwavering commitment to every student’ success, most notably through her visionary leadership in the English Learner Conversation program...She led the English Learner Conversation program at the Fremont High since January 2024...Please re-elect Rosa Kim for the FUHSD school board to continue the leadership in our District.

## I am proud to offer my endorsement of Rosa Kim for the FUHSD School Board. Over the past 2025-2026 school year serving as the FUHSD Student Board Representative, I can confidently saw that Rosa is one of the kindest, most down-to-earth leaders that I know. Rosa is willing to go above and beyond in meeting students where they are, always looking for ways to make the FUHSD district a better place. Rosa’s extensive experience on the district board helps offer the district multiple angles when decisions are being made. I’ve worked firsthand with Rosa and I have full confidence that Rosa will continue to serve FUHSD with the same care and dedication for another team on the district Board.
## Amy Tang
FUHSD Student Board Representative, 2025-26
